headline: AI-made videos of characters from Malayalam-language films, the cinema of the Indian state of Kerala, dancing and battling to rap tracks are drawing large audiences on social media.
score_reason: Pool 1 kept at the floor: a regional social-media trend described through a few interviews.
importance_line: Viewers in Kerala and the creators of AI videos are part of a meme wave that some enjoy and some are tired of, but the story rests on a few interviews and gives no data on how wide the trend is.
summary: The New Indian Express reports that AI-made videos of Malayalam film characters such as Nagavalli and Vasu Annan dancing to rap and pop tracks are spreading in Kerala, with one clip past 450,000 views and some Nagavalli reels past a million. The trend grew from a playful rivalry between actors' fan pages, and the people interviewed are split between enjoying it as light relief and tiring of too many AI trends.
notes: Read from the pre-fetched text. Malayalam is the main language of Kerala (general background, not from the article).
